afterDefects: The player (yellow) is crowded and partly hidden by three blue clone ninjas; a raised green-and-cobble ribbon floats over a flat, streaky water plane with no banks; the waterfall looks like a flat card hanging between rock blocks; the colours are oversaturated, with a pink sky clashing against orange rocks and green grass; the rock pillars look like plain boxes; the composition is cluttered.

Player is a flat, see-through yellow figure that blends into the warm path. Four blue/pink clone figures crowd the subject and look like placeholders. The waterfall sheet seems to hang in mid-air with no base pool, and the rock block above it looks pasted on. The water/sand plane on the right is flat and stripy with no texture. The oversaturated magenta sky and orange boulders clash, and the overall look is garish and lacks cohesion.

The player is a flat, unshaded yellow figure partly crowded by four pastel-blue ninjas, so the subject is harder to read. The waterfall is a flat translucent sheet with a rock slab perched on top that looks like it is floating. The path and grass strip sit oddly above a flat streaky water plane with hard edges. The pink sky is saturated and gives strong mood, but the composition feels cluttered and the geometry looks more like a placeholder.
